Saturday Geezer Ride

Redding, CA · Clover Creek Preserve · Road · Social

Saturday Geezer Ride is a road and social group ride in Redding, CA. It rolls every Saturday at 8:00 am from Clover Creek Preserve.

Next ride Sat, Oct 3, 8:00 AM PDT

How we know

The Shasta Wheelmen's public Google Calendar lists Geezers ride on Sat Oct 3, 2026 at 8:00 am from Clover Creek Preserve and the same ride every Saturday in September (feed read Oct 1, 2026).

For visitors

Non-members bring a signed waiver (form on the club site). The club says it is for riders of a certain age. Only Oct 3 is posted so far; later October Saturdays list the club weekend rides instead, so check the calendar.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social, "no murderous pace". It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Saturday Geezer Ride group ride

A Saturday social ride from Clover Creek Preserve to Anderson River Park and back, with coffee and talk at the Starbucks or Holiday Market on Hartnell and Shasta View. The club calls it social with no drops. It rolls at 8:00 on the dot.
